pack.name: Groomer Pack
pack.line: A booking site, before-and-after posts, rebook texts and a pricing sheet.

prompts.title: Before and after captions
prompts.summary: Short captions for a before-and-after post, in your voice.
prompts.prompt: Write five short captions for before-and-after grooming photos at [shop]. Facts: breed [ ], what we did [ ], how long [ ]. Voice: [paste a caption you like]. Use the dog's name only if I write "owner said yes". End with how to book: [link].
prompts.use: Ask owners at drop-off if you can post their dog.

prompts.title: Rebook texts
prompts.summary: Rebook texts at four, six and eight weeks, by coat type.
prompts.prompt: Write three short rebook texts for [shop]: one at four weeks for short coats, one at six for doodles and curly coats, one at eight for everyone else. Each under 30 words, with the booking link [link], and a way to reply STOP.
prompts.use: Send from your booking app or phone.

prompts.title: Price by size and coat
prompts.summary: Builds your grooming price list from your time on the table and the price per hour you want.
prompts.prompt: Help me set grooming prices for [shop]. My target per hour: [$]. Typical table time: small [min], medium [min], large [min], extra for matting [min per level], doodle coat [min]. Build a price list by size and service, with a matting fee, and a line for how I explain it to an owner.
prompts.use: Print the list for the front desk.
